description: Exact model tool inputs from the 2026-10-21 live Hippopotamus/Lion failures. Text, actors, and IDs are unchanged; comparison evidence now includes both masses.

beats.text: The Lion closes in fast, its top speed of 80 km/h carrying it toward the Hippopotamus across the open ground.
The Hippopotamus holds its ground, a massive body at 1500 kg standing against the smaller Lion at 190 kg.
The Lion tries to grapple with the Hippopotamus, but the sheer bulk of the Hippopotamus, roughly 7.9 times the Lion's weight, makes the hold difficult to maintain.
The Hippopotamus turns its 3.5 m frame toward the Lion and pushes forward, using its superior fighting ability to press the attack.
The Lion attempts to pull back and retreat from the Hippopotamus's advance, unable to break free of the pressure.

finish.text: In this hypothetical matchup, the Hippopotamus prevails through its superior fighting ability, outweighing the Lion by about 7.9 to 1 at 1500 kg against 190 kg.

beats.text: The Lion approaches the Hippopotamus quickly, testing the ground between them in this hypothetical matchup.
The Hippopotamus stands its ground as the Lion closes in, its bulk looming over the smaller cat.
The Lion charges with its top speed of 80 km/h, aiming to reach the Hippopotamus before it can settle.
The Hippopotamus answers with a powerful bite, its heavier frame of 1500 kg bearing down on the Lion.
The Hippopotamus holds the advantage, outweighing the Lion by about 7.9 to 1 at 1500 kg against 190 kg.
The Lion attempts to break away, but its speed of 80 km/h cannot free it from the Hippopotamus.

finish.text: In this hypothetical matchup, the Hippopotamus prevails through its superior fighting ability, outweighing the Lion by about 7.9 to 1 at 1500 kg against 190 kg.
